intents: Find me 50 right-fit people with verified emails
Find retail or wholesale buyers and distributors for our products
Give me an ABM target account list
Top up last month's list with the next 30
reads: brand brain: business context, target customers / audience, learnings incl. do-not-contact rules (learn-my-brand); customers, logos, win/loss notes are usually not on file — asked of the human
brand brain: competitor set — domains only (research-competitors / server)
brand documents + workspace files: newest 'Prospect fit definition' and 'Outreach lessons' (this playbook, earlier runs)
workspace research/audience/ledger.csv (outcomes-ledger, earlier runs) and research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md (every playbook that buys public data, via spend-gate)
claims: 'Claims you may use' facts via claims-gate (learn-my-brand) — for each segment's proof line
human-supplied: customer / open-deal / do-not-contact exports, account-value rule, warm-path lists, email-checker results, outreach outcomes

workspace research/audience/ledger.csv — read by every later run (exclusions, suppression, outcomes) via outcomes-ledger
workspace research/audience/fit-definition.md → brand document 'Prospect fit definition — <Brand> — <date>' (supersede) — read by later runs
workspace research/audience/lessons/<date>.md → brand document 'Outreach lessons — <Brand> — <date>' (keep-history; per-segment numbers, no personal data) — read by later runs
research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md rows — read by every playbook's spend estimates
